broker.name: FxPro
broker.tagline: On its own site since 1999. Its site names FCA, SCB, and FSA (Seychelles). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:500.
broker.about: FxPro says it has operated since 1999. An address it publishes is 80 Coleman Street, EC2R 5BJ London, UK. Account names on its site include Standard (MT4/MT5), Raw+, Elite, cTrader, and Spread betting. Platforms named there include FxPro mobile app, FxPro WebTrader, MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, cTrader, TradingView, and FxPro platform. The site names these regulators: FCA, SCB, and FSA (Seychelles). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:500. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

regulators.entity: Invemonde Trading Ltd in partnership with FxPro Global Markets Ltd

broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FCA: FxPro UK Limited, 509956. SCB: FxPro Global Markets Limited, SIA-F184. FSA (Seychelles): Invemonde Trading Ltd in partnership with FxPro Global Markets Ltd, SD120.

plans.name: Standard (MT4/MT5)
plans.billing_note: FX majors all-inclusive spread from 1.2 pips. Gold from 25 cents. Bitcoin from 15 USD. Other instruments floating spreads. Zero commission on Standard. Trade size from 0.01.

plans.name: Raw+
plans.billing_note: FX majors from 0 pips plus commission $3.5 per side. Gold from 10 cents plus $3.5 per side. Bitcoin from 0 USD plus $5 per side. Homepage also says zero spreads for 90%+ of the trading day and commission max 3.5 USD per lot per side.

plans.name: Elite
plans.billing_note: Same quoted Raw+ costs on the comparison page, plus rebates. Homepage says rebates of up to 21% of commissions.

plans.name: cTrader
plans.billing_note: ultra-low spreads from 0.2 and commission of $35 per $1 million traded. Comparison page: FX and metals, low spread plus $35 per $1 million traded on opening and on closing. Indices, energy and cryptos: marked-up floating spreads and zero commissions.

plans.name: Spread betting
plans.price: UK clients of FxPro UK Limited
plans.billing_note: Accounts FAQ says spread betting is available to UK-resident clients of FxPro UK Limited. Same FAQ says spread betting is charged via the spread, with a small mark-up, and no commission, plus any swap.

Spot and futures indices, spot and futures energies

leverage.note: Retail leverage page. Dynamic leverage reduces the maximum as volume increases on FxPro, MT4 and MT5.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Accounts FAQ: the standard account has no fixed minimum deposit. FxPro recommends an initial deposit of 1,000 USD. Some payment methods have their own minimums.

other_fees.label: Deposits and withdrawals
other_fees.value: FxPro does not charge fees or commission
other_fees.note: Deposit-methods page excerpt: payment providers, especially banks, may charge. E-wallet withdrawals may have a fee only if you have not traded. Bank wire deposits: FxPro and its receiving bank do not charge; other banks may.

other_fees.label: Swaps
other_fees.note: Charged at 21:59 UK time. Triple charge on Wednesday for FX and metals, and on Friday for other instruments. No swaps on futures. Swap-free accounts exist with conditions.
